title: Round 7 (v7): confirmatory tests for the C paper (H1 window-search leakage, H2 EC gain vs tuning protocol) and the main line (H3 dense-SNP gain under oracle tuning)
status: FROZEN after R4-R6 results and the R5 post-hoc finding, before any R7 analysis. H1/H2 were generated on the G2F forward-year split (discovery); that split is EXCLUDED from H1/H2 confirmatory settings.

settings.S1_G2F_LOYO: G2F 2014-2021; each year held out once, train on all other years; test env inclusion >=30 genotyped hybrids with yield (round-1 rule); round-1 features (2k SNP, PC1..30, 21 EC_env, predicted maturity)
settings.S2_G2F_LOLO: G2F leave-location-group-out: location = Env code with the trailing _YYYY removed; unique locations assigned to 5 folds by numpy default_rng(20260929).permutation of the sorted location list, fold = rank mod 5; all years of a held-out location are test; same inclusion rule
settings.S3_BRIWECS_LOYO: BRIWECS 2015-2020 (all years with phenotype + weather + >=30 genotyped cultivars per env); each year held out once; round-3 features (62,420 SNPs, PCs, 12 EC_env anchored at predicted heading)
settings.S0_G2F_forward: round-1 forward years 2019/2020/2021 (77 envs) - used ONLY for H3

penalty_grid.note: extended vs round 1 (grid-edge issue in R6); SNP-block penalty for 98k models = lambda * p_98k/p_2k as in R6; all protocols use this same grid; report fraction of folds where the chosen lambda is at a grid edge

tuning_protocols.P1_single_year: S1/S3: inner validation = the training year nearest in time to the held-out year (tie -> earlier year); S2: inner validation = 1 of the 4 training location folds, chosen as the next fold index mod 5; S0: last training year (round-1 rule). Select lambda by mean within-env r on the validation envs, refit on all training data.
tuning_protocols.P2_oracle: lambda chosen per model per fold to maximize mean within-env r on the TEST envs (upper-bound / leaky reference)
tuning_protocols.P3_grouped_inner_cv: S1/S3: leave-one-training-year-out inner CV over all training years; S2: 4-fold inner CV over the training location folds; select lambda maximizing the mean (over inner folds) of mean within-env r, refit on all training data

models.M_G_98k: 98k SNP main effects only (G2F only, H3 secondary)

H1_window_search_leak.procedure: CERIS-style search as R5 C2. G2F variables and window grid as prereg v5. BRIWECS: all daily meteorological variables present for all sites in the DWD_Intpol files (list them before any yield-related computation), plus VPD by Tetens if temperature and relative humidity exist; windows in days from 1 January of the harvest year, d1 in 0..180 step 5, d2 in d1+10..d1+60 step 5. Nested = search on the fold's training envs; leaky = search on training + test envs. Env-mean model = linear regression of env-mean yield on the selected index, fit on training envs.
H1_window_search_leak.metric: pooled out-of-fold env-mean r: Pearson between predicted and observed env-mean yield over all test envs of the setting (each env predicted once)
H1_window_search_leak.optimism: r_envmean(leaky) - r_envmean(nested); also within-env r of the C2 GxE model as R5 (reported)
H1_window_search_leak.CONFIRMED: optimism >= 0.05 with env-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 in >= 2 of the 3 settings

H2_EC_gain_tuning_dependence.quantities: Delta_EC(P) = r(M0plus) - r(M_G) under protocol P (both models tuned by the same protocol); D = Delta_EC(P1) - Delta_EC(P2)
H2_EC_gain_tuning_dependence.CONFIRMED: D >= 0.01 with paired env-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 in >= 2 of the 3 settings
H2_EC_gain_tuning_dependence.also_report: Delta_EC under P1, P2, P3 with CIs; M_G and M0plus tuning optimism r(P2)-r(P1); Delta_EC(P3) is the recommended honest estimate
H2_EC_gain_tuning_dependence.direction_note: If D is significantly NEGATIVE in >= 2 settings, report as 'EC gain larger under oracle tuning' (hypothesis refuted, opposite direction)

H3_dense_snp_under_oracle.quantity: Delta_98k(P) = r(M0plus_98k) - r(M0plus_2k), both tuned by protocol P
H3_dense_snp_under_oracle.CONFIRMED: Delta_98k(P2) >= 0.01 with CI lower > 0 in BOTH settings, AND Delta_98k(P1) CI lower > 0 in S1
H3_dense_snp_under_oracle.secondary: r(M_G_98k) - r(M_G) under P1 and P2 (dense-SNP gain without EC terms)

paper_level_decision.C_CONFIRMED_STRONG: H1 and H2 both CONFIRMED -> C paper aimed at target tier
paper_level_decision.C_PARTIAL: exactly one of H1/H2 CONFIRMED -> C paper built on the confirmed one; the other reported as not replicated
paper_level_decision.C_NOT_CONFIRMED: neither -> C remains an evaluation-protocol note (stable tier)
paper_level_decision.MAINLINE: H3 CONFIRMED -> 98k SNP default in the kernel-gated main line; otherwise report that the R6 gain depends on tuning

metric_and_uncertainty: within-env Pearson equal-weight over out-of-fold test envs; paired env bootstrap 2000, seed 20260928; Holm across the settings of each hypothesis reported alongside (decision uses unadjusted CI as specified)
compute: threads <=4 per process, resident memory <5 GB per process; two processes may run concurrently
reporting_rules: results frozen as JSON with sha256
